class.name: EquipmentManagerComponent
class.brief_description: What a pawn has on: equips, unequips, and shows it on every peer.
class.description: Sits beside the [Pawn] under the pawn's root, next to the [AbilitySystemComponent] it grants abilities through. The server equips and unequips; every peer in [member replication_mode] - everyone by default, so you see the axe in a friend's hand - gets the same [EquipmentInstance] with the same scenes spawned. When the pawn leaves the tree everything comes off, and on the server the granted abilities, effects and tags are taken back. Usually driven by a [QuickBarComponent]; [method equip_item] also works on its own, e.g. for armour.

method.name: client_receive_full_state
method.description: RPC: everything on, sent to a client that asked.

method.name: equip_item
method.description: Server: puts the equipment on and returns its instance. [param instigator] is what it came from - usually the [InventoryItemInstance] - and becomes the source object of the granted abilities.

method.name: find_instance_by_definition
method.description: The first instance of the definition, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: find_instance_by_item_id
method.description: The instance put on by the item with this id, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_equipment_instances
method.description: Everything on, in the order it was put on.

method.name: get_first_instance_of_type
method.description: The first instance whose script is or extends the given class - a [code]class_name[/code], a script, or a native class name.

method.name: is_mirror
method.description: True on a networked client holding a mirror.

method.name: server_request_full_state
method.description: RPC: a client asks for everything on.

signal.name: item_equipped
signal.description: Something was put on - on every peer it reaches.

signal.name: replicated_state_received
signal.description: A client's mirror got the whole state.

constants.constant: Every peer keeps its own, as offline.
Only the peer owning the pawn sees it.
